detail.description: Entries grouped by project, newest first; each shows its kind as a tag (confirm, proposal, question), the stage, the diagram's name, for a confirmation why it waits (never confirmed, lifted by a new document, cancelled), and how long it has waited. A failed backup shows as a warning on top until a backup succeeds. From the mockup: the header's "My turn N" is this list's count. On a phone: the same list in one column.
Grey rows in the list's places, two per project group; no buttons.
"Nothing waits for you" and the project list (SPEC-042). With no project yet: "A project appears here when an agent sends it for the first time", and a link to the agent credentials on SCR-143.
"Something went wrong. Try again." with a retry and the request's traceId; the header still works.
401: the gate, then back here. 403: only "Only the owner of this NEXUS can open it".
"Read at 10:42" beside the title; the list reads again when the tab comes back into view. An entry answered meanwhile opens to its new state on SCR-145.

Projects as rows, newest send first, each with "N of 13 stages passed" and its to-do count; a row opens SCR-144, which has each stage's state and the tool links. Under them the credentials table with a revoke button per row and an issue form. After a deletion on SCR-144, "Deleted demo" shows on top once. On a phone: projects and credentials read-only; issue and revoke are not offered, with "Do this on a PC".
Grey rows for projects and credentials in their places; the issue form is off.
No project: "A project appears here when an agent sends it for the first time: issue a credential below, set it in the hub and push with --first." No credential: "No agent can send yet."
A failed read: a message and a retry per table, so the other table still shows. A refused issue: the message by the name field, the name kept.
401: the gate, then back here. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload.
"Read at 10:42"; read again when the tab comes back into view.

The new credential's secret in a box with a copy button, "It shows only now", and `corthex-hub` setup words. Leaving or reloading the page hides it for good (SPEC-049). A phone never shows it, since issuing is on a PC; its 360-pixel frame is a narrow PC window.

The stages grouped by part, 13 per part (a project without parts is one group), as rows with a state tag, the date of the last checkpoint and its links; a passed stage whose confirmation was lifted says "changed since the pass" (SPEC-035). Tool links show their status and the time it was read, or "not read yet". On a phone: stages and links read-only; linking, removing links and deleting are not offered, with "Do this on a PC".
Thirteen grey rows per part in the stage list's places; the #data section's counts are grey.
A space with nothing drawn yet: every stage says "Nothing sent yet".
404: "This project is not in NEXUS" and a link to the projects. Others: a message and a retry. A refused link: the message by the address, kept.
401: the gate, then back here. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload.
"Read at 10:42"; read again when the tab comes back into view.

At #data: the counts of snapshots, diagrams, comments, confirmations and layouts that go, a field for the project's name and a delete button that turns on when the name matches. After the delete, the projects list opens. Deleting is on a PC; the 360-pixel frame is a narrow PC window.

The mockup's workbench: stage tabs under the header; the diagram or item table in the middle with dashed AI proposals and the legend; the work panel on the right with three sections. "This diagram": its state ("not confirmed", "confirmed", "N places changed since the confirmation") with up to four changes and "+N more" to SCR-146, "AI proposals left out are not confirmed", and the confirm button. "AI proposals": each with its kind, text and reason, and Accept and Reject ("All answered" when none). "Selected": the element's kind, name, its threads and the comment box with AI and owner badges. A never-confirmed diagram says nothing is marked (SPEC-034); a part of the document that cannot be read is left out with its file and line (SPEC-003). By stage: 03 draws each user flow as one diagram of its steps, decisions and labelled arrows, top to bottom as its Mermaid source says (SPEC-006); 08 draws one panel per state of a screen, with the state's name, its description and the responses that lead to it, and a state without a description is an empty panel marked "No description" (SPEC-008); 09 shows the mockup page in a frame isolated from NEXUS, its own links and tabs working inside it, and lists the design tokens it uses in the panel under "This diagram" (SPEC-009). Those stages have one diagram per file, listed above the diagram; choosing one opens it. A removed diagram that has an open thread, a proposed AI proposal or a direct edit waiting for reflection comes last, marked removed, and opens for these only: its threads are read, answered and closed, its proposals show Reject and never Accept, and the "This diagram" section lists its direct edits waiting for reflection in place of the confirm button, each with Cancel edit (on a phone, the list without it); no new comment, move, direct edit, confirm button or Cancel confirmation shows (SPEC-027). A mockup's elements are its tokens, so a token is selected and commented on like any element; on a phone the token list follows the frame. The view reads the page's status before it frames it. A bar above the frame always marks it as a mockup page, and NEXUS never asks for a sign-in inside it, since text typed into the page can leave with a page it opens. When the page opens another page in its frame, the view opens the mockup page again once with "The mockup tried to open another page."; when it does so again, it stops with "The mockup keeps opening other pages" and Open again. A mockup takes no AI proposals: on stage 09 the "AI proposals" section says so, and agents comment on its tokens or on the mockup instead. Every element, a flow's box, a state panel or a token, is selected by keyboard too and shows that it is selected. On a phone: the diagram fills the width and the panel is a sheet under it with the threads and the comment box only; moving, renaming, connecting, cancelling edits, answering proposals, confirming and cancelling a confirmation are not offered, with "Do this on a PC" (SPEC-051).
The tab row and the panel's section titles stay; the diagram area and the panel's lists are grey shapes in their places, so nothing moves when the data arrives.
Nothing sent for this stage: "Nothing sent yet. An agent sends it with the next push." An item table with no items: "This stage has no items yet" (SPEC-005).

404 for the diagram: after a write, the diagram is read again first, and a removed one still listed opens for its threads, its proposals' Reject and its waiting direct edits' Cancel edit only (SPEC-027); otherwise "This diagram is not in NEXUS" and a link to the project. For an element, a thread or a change: "no longer in NEXUS" and a reload. A refused input: the message by it, kept. Others: a message and a retry; the rest of the workbench still works.
401: the gate, then back here, with an unsent comment kept. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload.
A bar over the diagram: "The document changed. Look at the new version." (or "already decided", "this thread is closed", "the workshop is closed") with a reload; typed text is kept.

Changes waiting for reflection: their elements carry the mark; the confirm button is off with "Reflect or cancel the waiting changes first" and a list of them, each with Cancel edit (SPEC-029). On a phone, the marks and the list only, without Cancel edit.

"Confirmed at this version. The stage passes when the agent records it." and Cancel confirmation; after the record, "Recorded" with its pull request. On a phone, the message without Cancel confirmation.

The document does not draw: "Fix the document so that it draws, then confirm." with where the drawing failed; the confirm button is off. A user flow that does not parse shows its source text with the error line marked (SPEC-006); a mockup that cannot be shown, such as one never drawn, shows its name and the reason in place of the page (SPEC-009).

Stage 01 while a workshop is open: one frame per step, free sticky notes in the six kinds, the step's Confirm, and Import from Miro; a step without notes says "Add notes before confirming". On a phone, the board read-only with "Do this on a PC": no sticky notes, step confirmation or import (SPEC-051).

drawings.name: SCR-146 Changes since the last confirmation

detail.description: One row per changed element: a tag (added, removed, changed) and its name from the current diagram, or its key when it was removed; above the list, a link to the document at the confirmed version in the repository, as the "before" (SPEC-034); the confirm button at the end. From the mockup: the work panel's "changed since the confirmation" list in full. For a removed diagram only the changes show, with no confirm button (SPEC-027). On a phone: the list read-only; Cancel edit and Confirm are not offered, with "Do this on a PC".
Grey rows in the list's places; the confirm button is off.
Never confirmed: "Not confirmed yet, so there is nothing to compare with." Nothing changed: "Nothing changed since the confirmation." (SPEC-034)

404: after a confirmation, the diagram is read again first, and a removed one still listed shows only its changes, with no confirm button (SPEC-027); otherwise the diagram or the change is gone, with a link to the project or a reload; others: a message and a retry.
401: the gate, then back here. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload.
"The document changed. Look at the new version." with a reload.
Direct edits waiting for reflection: they come first, each with Cancel edit (on a phone, without it), and the confirm button is off with "Reflect or cancel the waiting changes first".
The document does not draw: the confirm button is off with "Fix the document so that it draws, then confirm." and a link to the diagram, where the failure shows. Only confirming on a PC leads here.
"Confirmed at this version. The stage passes when the agent records it." over an empty list, with the way back to the diagram. Only confirming on a PC leads here.
